semantics.scope: Current ordinary Plex queue only; paused playback is allowed.
semantics.all: Repeat the retained listed order after the last item without reshuffling.
semantics.success: Return an active nonempty queue with the exact requested repeat mode, runtime and negotiated state version.
semantics.rollout: Require the separate marker and successful true-only controller probe before sending one repeat mutation. Never retry or downgrade after dispatch.
semantics.limits: Check response-version queue size limits before changing repeat; legacy requests cannot mutate queues whose state requires v2.

refusals.stopped: Plex playback is unavailable on this player.
refusals.pending_target: Plex queue request is already in progress.
refusals.stale_binding: Player context changed before Plex playback.
refusals.kiosk: Kiosk mode does not allow a Plex queue.
refusals.parental: Unlock parental access before starting the Plex queue.
refusals.state_upgrade: This queue requires plex_queue_state_v2 and state_version: 2; upgrade the controller
